useCases: Display and edit a contact's communication channels (phone, email, web, social)
taxonomy.whenToUse: Use on Contact or Account pages to manage communication channels (phone, email, web, social).
taxonomy.whenNotToUse: Do not point it at a custom communication-like table — it expects the standard ContactCommunication/AccountCommunication shape (CommunicationType/Number/master FK) and fails at runtime otherwise. For a custom record's own type/value detail use crt.DataGrid instead.
taxonomy.entityCouplingNote: Edits the built-in ContactCommunication/AccountCommunication model, but the page's primary entity need not be Contact/Account: bind items to a Contact/Account-derived datasource and masterRecordColumnValue to a Contact/Account reference (a lookup attribute on a custom entity, or $Id when the page entity is itself Contact/Account).

useCases: Display records in rows and columns with sorting and selection
taxonomy.whenToUse: Use for tabular data with columns, sorting, and row selection.
taxonomy.whenNotToUse: Not for image/photo collections (use crt.Gallery); on dashboards/home pages use crt.ListWidget.

useCases: Display and manage a list of file attachments on a record
taxonomy.whenToUse: Use to list and manage file attachments (documents) on a record.
taxonomy.whenNotToUse: Not for displaying images as a visual gallery (use crt.Gallery) or a single image (use crt.ImageInput).

useCases: Display a collection of images or photos as browsable preview cards
taxonomy.whenToUse: Use for an image or photo gallery — the right choice for any image-gallery or photo-grid prompt.
taxonomy.whenNotToUse: Not for tabular records with columns (use crt.DataGrid) or a single image field (use crt.ImageInput).

useCases: Upload or display a single image such as an avatar, logo, or cover
taxonomy.whenToUse: Use for a single image field — upload or display one picture (avatar, logo, cover).
taxonomy.whenNotToUse: Not for a collection of images (use crt.Gallery).

useCases: Show a collection of records in a widget on a dashboard or home page
taxonomy.whenToUse: Use on dashboards and home pages to show a record collection in a widget card.
taxonomy.whenNotToUse: Not for a record or list page (use crt.DataGrid); not for charts (use crt.ChartWidget).
